fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear width and overhead clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the main residence and detached structure to keep walls and foundation lines visible to arriving responders.
• Mark the rear access point with a reflective sign or marker so responders can locate it quickly under low-light or smoky conditions.
• Keep the rear access gate unlocked or secured with a breakaway latch to allow responders to reach the back of the property without delay.
• Clear a path between the vehicle parking area and the detached structure wide enough for responders carrying equipment on foot.
• Trim shrubs and overhanging branches at each access point so responders can move through without obstruction.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure free of stored items, planters, or other objects that could slow foot movement during an emergency.
• Post the property address in numbers large enough to read from the road, at the access drive entrance.

wildfire.conditions: Large Trees; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Scattered Shrubs; Open Green Space; Multiple Access Routes; Vegetation Along Driveway; Brush Area; Ground Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that hang directly over or within a few feet of the roof and eaves.
• Thin the scattered trees nearest to the structure to create more open space between their canopies and the building.
• Remove shrubs and low plants growing directly against the foundation and exterior walls.
• Clear brush from the area immediately surrounding the structure, keeping the ground closest to the house as open as possible.
• Thin or remove shrubs clustered together near the structure to break up the continuous plant material between the brush area and the building.
• Trim overhanging branches and cut back shrubs along the driveway edges to keep both travel lanes fully clear for vehicles.
• Mow or cut ground vegetation around the structure and along access routes regularly to keep it short.
• Remove dead plant material, dry leaves, and loose debris from the ground beneath trees near the structure.
• Keep both access routes clear of fallen branches and overgrown vegetation so they remain passable.
• Separate any firewood piles, lumber, or stored materials from the exterior walls of the structure.
